limitations: Answer correctness is not measured on FinanceBench arithmetic; the compiler is certified on hand-computed fixtures instead.
Cell localization grants credit for a matching value anywhere in the target document; it does not prove the question's intended metric was selected.
No untouched mixed abstention holdout exists; positives and negatives come from one fixture document.

preregistration.abstention: balanced mixed set; no tuning on a holdout, but no untouched mixed holdout exists, which is reported as a limitation
preregistration.calculation_correctness: replayed hand-computed fixture cases only; FinanceBench arithmetic questions are counted as unsupported
preregistration.cell_localization: a verified cell in the target document carries the reference value within 0.5% at the cell's stated scale

unsupported_types: arithmetic questions requiring concept mapping the current compiler does not support
questions whose reference answer is not a single numeric value
documents whose tables have no verified cells
